taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-08, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 218.1 | 18.02 | 18.02
2 | 105.0 | 1.05 | 19.07
3 | 60.0 | 1.04 | 20.11
4 | 317.3 | 0.57 | 20.68
5 | 1743.2 | 5.17 | 25.85
6 | 2231.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as QHAA-type.

Is this label correct for these layer values? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"label_correct": true or false, "curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we examine the resistivities of the six layers in groups of three:

1.  **Layers 1-2-3:** $\rho_1 = 218.1$, $\rho_2 = 105.0$, $\rho_3 = 60.0$. Since $218.1 > 105.0 > 60.0$, this corresponds to the letter **Q**.
2.  **Layers 2-3-4:** $\rho_2 = 105.0$, $\rho_3 = 60.0$, $\rho_4 = 317.3$. Since $105.0 > 60.0 < 317.3$, this corresponds to the letter **H**.
3.  **Layers 3-4-5:** $\rho_3 = 60.0$, $\rho_4 = 317.3$, $\rho_5 = 1743.2$. Since $60.0 < 317.3 < 1743.2$, this corresponds to the letter **A**.
4.  **Layers 4-5-6:** $\rho_4 = 317.3$, $\rho_5 = 1743.2$, $\rho_6 = 2231.3$. Since $317.3 < 1743.2 < 2231.3$, this corresponds to the letter **A**.

Combining these letters in depth order, we get **QHAA**. This matches the classification provided.

{"label_correct": true, "curve_type": "QHAA"}
